newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsuzuka, Summers may meet next week -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Mitsuzuka, Summers may meet next week -- MOF.

text.p: Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka aims to meet U.S. Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers next week, ministry officials said on Wednesday.
Summers will be in Tokyo on March 4 to attend a meeting of senior financial officials from five Asian economies and the United States to discuss cooperation in financial markets.
If the bilateral meeting is held, U.S. authorities are expected to express their views on the recent condition of the U.S. stock and bond markets, one Finance Ministry official said.
They also said that the U.S. government may ask its Japanese counterpart its view on the prospects for a Japanese economic recovery led by domestic demand.

There may also be discussions over the state of the Japanese financial system, in which case the government will explain that Japanese banks have progressed steadily in their efforts to resolve their bad loan problems, the officials said.
They said the meeting had not yet been confirmed as Mitsuzuka's schedule may need to be adjusted because of Japan's parliament is currently in session.
